title: The Sticker Sheet Divided Fairly
youtube_title: The Sticker Sheet Divided Fairly | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Staying beside someone is sometimes the whole gift.
summary: At a bedroom rug of cushions, puppets, and paper, Ines is just outside the fun, close to a sticker sheet that could be divided before anyone asked. Jorie changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Ines has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Papa lets the children solve it.
